text.text_excerpt: This place gave us one of the most enjoyable evenings of our NOLA trip. Great food, drinks, music, and atmosphere! We got to Three Muses what appeared to be before the Sunday evening rush (around 7pm?) and got a couple of seats by the bar. Started off with grapefruit/champagne and earl grey cocktail. The drinks were made and served quickly, and my boyfriend and I loved both of them! Easy to drink (dangerously easy!) and a great blend of ingredients. Not too strong, but not too sugary sweet either. Pretty reasonably priced at $10-12 per cocktail. We began looking at food and decided to start with some olives (my favorite!) and then share the tofu rice bowl. The olives were very tasty, not ...

I loved this place. We came here three times on our trip to NOLA! The first time was to grab a quick dinner - they've got a great menu of small plates. We ordered the fried green tomatoes topped with crab salad and the buckwheat noodles with kale salad. Both dishes were so delicious. We also ordered cocktails from their menu. There was also live music and the band was really great. The atmosphere of this place was just super cool and friendly. We were so impressed that we came back for dinner the next day. Good Music, Good Drinks, and Good Food with Korean glaze. This was a Yelp find, so first, Thank you, Yelp. This joint is located on the ever popular Frenchman St, which in itself is a place that I think a visitor should check out. We got to the Three Muses on a Sunday Night and it was still jumping. We started with round of the Muse cocktails (Cucumber-Infused Hendrick's Gin, Blueberry Syrup, St. Germain, Lime) and they were delicious. We ate many small places, but my favorites were the Mac and Cheese, Sesame-Crusted Calamari Fries and fluffernutter pie. The fish taco and duck leg with spaetzle were also awesome.
